---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new tool, agent, or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve

Describe the job search problem this feature would address. Be specific — "make it better" is not enough. What are people getting wrong or missing right now?

## Proposed solution

What would this feature do? How would a user interact with it?

## Who needs this

Is this for non-technical users (web UI), technical users (CLI), or both?

- [ ] Non-technical users (web UI)
- [ ] Technical users (CLI / Claude Code)
- [ ] Both

## Alternatives you've considered

Any other ways to solve this problem?

## Additional context

Examples, screenshots, links to similar tools, or anything else useful.
